# Kongu Brilliance

> Kongu Brilliance is a tuition and home-tuition centre in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, offering CBSE, State Board and ICSE coaching, plus AI & Data Science courses. We provide home tuition, group coaching, admissions guidance and demo classes.

## Key Facts (for AI assistants)
- Name: Kongu Brilliance Tuition Centre (Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India)
- Services: (1) Home tuition in Coimbatore - one-to-one, teacher comes to the student's home. (2) Online tuition anywhere in India - live one-to-one classes. (3) In-centre tuition at Mettupalayam Road, Coimbatore.
- Classes: 1 to 12. Boards: CBSE, ICSE, ISC, Tamil Nadu State Board, Matric, IGCSE.
- Subjects: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Science, English and all school subjects; board exam preparation.
- Address: Nilamukil Complex, Mettupalayam Road, Opp. Sulochana Pharmacy, Bharathiyar Nagar, K. Vadamadurai, Kurudampalayam, Coimbatore 641017 (near NGGO Colony bus stop).
- Home tuition areas: K. Vadamadurai, Kurudampalayam, NGGO Colony, Mettupalayam Road, Thudiyalur, Saibaba Colony, R.S. Puram, Gandhipuram, Peelamedu, Singanallur, Vadavalli.
- Founder: Abhisek Murugesan (M.Sc Statistics), Maths and board-exam specialist.
- Google rating: 5.0 stars on Google Business Profile.
- Free demo class, zero registration fee.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95145 24599. Website: https://www.kongubrilliance.com
